title: RefundSurchargeAdvice
description: A refund surcharge advice calculates the amount of refundable surcharge and provides an adjusted refund transaction amount using the previous surcharge advice and the original parent transaction.

parentTransaction.title: ResourceURL<Transaction>
parentTransaction.description: Transaction [Resource URL](#section/Overview/Values) of the parent transaction for surcharge.

total.description: The refund total excluding the surcharge amount. A value for partial refund can be specified.

customReference.description: Optional reference provided by the merchant

customFields.description: Custom fields, an object containing arbitrary string values.  Field names and values must not exceed 64 and 1024 characters, respectively.
